heading: Amendment [a]
overall_rationale:
This amendment addresses
FDA feedback
changes to the schedule of activities
clarification of use of medications for chronic pain and rescue medication guidelines
sponsor protocol template updates to provide more trial execution flexibility
statistical analyses updates, and
other clarifications throughout the protocol.

heading: Amendment [b]
document_history: Document Date Amendment (a) 12 March 2021 Original Protocol 23 September 2020
overall_rationale:
This amendment allows participants to take certain doses of metformin based upon new PK 
modeling data and metformin prescribing information (GLUCOPHAGE package insert, 2018).

heading: Amendment [a] 12 March 2021
overall_rationale:
This amendment introduces a dose titration scheme for participants. The starting dose level is 
200 mg and decisions to change the dose level will be made by the investigator, in discussion 
with the participants, based on adverse events reported for tolerability. The changes for dose 
titration affect sections throughout the ISA. Additional updates were made according to 
emerging data and changes to the master protocol.
